name: ah-ci-repair
description: Repair a failing CI run on an existing pull request. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

steps.prompt: For repository {{repository}} pull request {{pull_request}}: read the failing check logs, identify the root cause from evidence, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files. Label anything not shown by logs as unverified. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Apply this fix: {{previous.output}} on the pull request branch, in a worktree under C:\wt. Run the failing check locally, commit and push. Repeat diagnose-and-fix at most three times in total; if still red, stop and report BLOCKED with the evidence. Do not force push. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Run the repository test, lint and build commands for the new head commit named in {{previous.output}} and report only failures with root-cause evidence. Do not change product code. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.
